name: IDX Multiresolution File Format
definition: IDX is a hierarchical multiresolution data format that enables fast and efficient access to large-scale scientific data by utilizing a hierarchical Z (HZ) order for storage, providing cache-oblivious, progressive access from coarse to fine resolution.
summary: IDX is a hierarchical multiresolution format enabling fast, cache-oblivious access to large datasets by storing samples in HZ order without redundant resolution data.
